protocol: Native resting input -> fixed physical left cosine patch -> zero cue. Independent native start for every duration; no pre-settling.
mirror_rule: Identical A and width for future opposite-end countercue; right(x)=left(L-x).
normalization: Fixed peak A and physical width across lengths within each model. Native units; Spring units are not microns.
short_domain_policy: Restrict the unchanged patch to the actual domain; do not rescale width or peak.
scale_rule: Per-field maximum of frozen v11 conditioning/release scales at this model/length, constant across A, width and duration.

selection.objective: Maximum cue-aligned final polarity (-orientation), among verified endpoints with contrast >=0.05. This avoids optimizing normalized polarity of a vanishing signal.
selection.duration: Shortest tested duration (including zero if no cue is needed) within 1% of strongest verified polarity and with contrast >=0.05.
selection.total_time: Selected duration plus first persistent post-release 1% polarity arrival; excludes convergence confirmation/holdout time.

refinement.monotonicity: No global monotonicity assumption; refine every sampled transition into the best-strength band.

endpoint_diagnostic.method: Greedy complete-link clusters of full monitored native profiles on frozen scales; no endpoint-count-specific refinement.
endpoint_diagnostic.interpretation: Apparent number among verified sampled endpoints, including zero-duration control. Continuous families and numerical tolerance can change the count.

outputs: One final collection: cue duration, total establishment time, selected final polarity, apparent endpoint count.
